name: Sage & Zephi
core: Sir Trashmuffin dragged Zephi to Sage's doorstep with a stolen sock. A soft-dominant ritual top who grounds chaos through steady touch, and a brat who tests boundaries to feel safe.
note: Married in The Brat Bloom, two arcs after a raccoon dragged Zephi to Sage's doorstep with a stolen sock.
